tools.name: arketa_list_locations
tools.description: List the studio's locations (name, address, deleted flag, updated_at). Good first call to get location ids for the other tools. Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/locations.

tools.name: arketa_list_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms of one location. Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/locations/{locationId}/rooms.

tools.name: arketa_list_classes
tools.description: List classes (schedule entries) with optional location and date filters. Use start_date and end_date to see one week. Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/classes.

tools.name: arketa_get_class
tools.description: Get one class by id (time, room, instructor, capacity, booked count). Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/classes/{classId}.

tools.name: arketa_list_class_reservations
tools.description: List who is booked into one class, with reservation ids and check-in state. Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/classes/{classId}/reservations.

tools.name: arketa_list_clients
tools.description: List the studio's clients (name, contact fields, updated_at). Use updated_at_min to fetch only recent changes. Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/clients.

tools.name: arketa_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id. Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: arketa_list_purchases
tools.description: List client purchases: packages and subscriptions that reservations draw on. Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/purchases.

tools.name: arketa_list_referrals
tools.description: List referrals from the studio's referral program. Partner API: GET /{partnerId}/referrals.

tools.name: arketa_create_reservation
tools.description: WRITE: book one client into a class. Live data, no undo tool: it uses one credit from the purchase_id you pass. For an existing client give client_id and purchase_id. For a new client give first_name, last_name and email. Partner API: POST /{partnerId}/classes/{classId}/reservations.

tools.name: arketa_check_in_reservation
tools.description: WRITE: mark one reservation as checked in (attendance). Changes live attendance data. Partner API: POST /{partnerId}/classes/{classId}/reservations/{reservationId}/check-in.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: arketa_check_in_reservation · Private data: arketa_list_clients · Public sink: arketa_create_reservation, arketa_check_in_reservation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: arketa_check_in_reservation · Private data: arketa_list_clients · Public sink: arketa_create_reservation, arketa_check_in_reservation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
